description: Compile business data into a deployable site: takes business (the pure-data site config { pack, brief, site, spec }, plus optional foundation and target) and optional out_dir, and returns { ok, pack, spec, files, findings }, with written and writtenTo when out_dir is given. `pack` is a registered pack id, `brief` is the verified business facts (name, category, phone, address, hours, reviews), `site` is deploy context (baseUrl, locales), and `spec` is the page structure; the files rendered are HTML, sitemap.xml, robots.txt, llms.txt, headers and icons. Validation runs at both the spec tier and the rendered tier, so an invalid site never produces output.

business.description: The site config object: { pack: "restaurant", brief: {...}, site: {...}, spec: {...}, foundation?: {...}, target?: "cloudflare" }.

out_dir.description: Write the compiled site to this directory. Omit to get the files in the response only.

name: compile_spec
title: Compile business data into a SiteSpec and a deployable site
